title: Sleeping Beauty
tagline: Make the cake without magic. Good luck.
about: A princess cursed by Maleficent is hidden in the forest by three good fairies until her sixteenth birthday.
cue: Serve dessert when the fairies try to bake the birthday cake without magic.
faces: “No magic in the kitchen, dear. We'll make the cake by hand, and it will be beautiful, I think. Merryweather, hold the flour.”
